settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage the system, branding and forms.
settings.subtitleReadOnly: View reports and manage your own account.
settings.tabsHint: Swipe sideways to see all tabs.

branding.title: White-label settings
branding.logoError: The logo must be uploaded through the app. External logo URLs are not allowed.
branding.logoHelp: Used in reports, email and the dashboard header. Uploaded to the app, not from an external address.

templates.createDesc: Create a new template that can be linked to future work orders.
templates.titlePlaceholder: Checklist name (e.g. Annual heat pump service)
templates.empty: You haven't created any checklist templates yet.
templates.createRequiresUnits: The report should be linked to equipment units
templates.deleteUsageWarning: The checklist "{title}" is in use ({reports} reports, {workOrders} work orders, {contracts} contracts). Are you sure you want to delete it?
templates.descriptionPlaceholder: Short description for the template library (optional)

tags.workOrdersDesc: Used to track work order readiness (e.g. ready, missing parts, needs review).
tags.emptyWorkOrders: No work order tags created yet.
tags.name: Name
tags.documentsDesc: Used to categorise and search the document library.

auditLog.title: System activity log
auditLog.desc: All system events and user activity.
auditLog.retentionDesc: Audit logs older than the retention period are purged automatically. Rows under legal hold are kept. 0 turns automatic purging off.
auditLog.retentionSaved: The retention period has been saved.
auditLog.exportDesc: Downloads a ZIP archive with a SHA-256 manifest and hash chain. The export itself is audited.
auditLog.holdDesc: Protect an audit row or a whole entity from automatic purging. The history itself is not changed.
auditLog.holdSaved: The legal hold has been recorded.
auditLog.holdReleased: The legal hold has been released.
auditLog.holdError: The action could not be completed. Check the details.

evidence.title: Work order evidence package
evidence.desc: Download one work order with customer, reports, revisions, attachments and relevant audit rows. The package is sealed with a SHA-256 manifest and can be verified offline.
evidence.empty: There are no work orders to export yet.
evidence.contents: work-order.json, customer.json, reports with revisions, attachments and signatures, audit/audit.jsonl, manifest.json and manifest.sha256. Missing files are listed with a reason.
evidence.verifyHint: Verify with sha256sum -c manifest.sha256 and compare the files in manifest.json. If a file changes, verification fails.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Create custom roles, change the permissions they grant, and remove roles that are no longer in use. Individual users can also get a customised permission list on their user row.
roles.name: Name
roles.descriptionPlaceholder: What the role is used for
roles.keyInfo: The role gets a fixed key based on its name. The key is used internally and does not change if you later change the display name.
roles.deleteBlocked: Move the users to another role first
roles.adminLocked: Administrators always have all permissions. The permission list cannot be changed.
roles.customerLocked: Customer portal users are controlled by their customer link, not by internal permissions.

errors.mangler_navn: The role must have a name.
errors.rollen_finnes: A role with this name already exists.
errors.rolle_i_bruk: The role is in use. Move the users to another role before deleting it.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Work orders and service agreements belong to a department. Employees only see work orders in their own department, while customers, documents and reports are shared.
departments.name: Name
departments.info: Work orders, service agreements and employees are linked to a department. Customers, documents and reports are still shared by everyone.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Manage keys for REST API integrations. Each key has the same permissions as the user who created it.
apiKeys.createDesc: The key is shown only once, right after it is created.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.expiresHint: Leave empty for the default lifetime of {days} days. Maximum lifetime is 365 days.
apiKeys.scopesHint: The key inherits the user's permissions but can only use the selected scope areas. Select at least one.
apiKeys.readOnlyHint: Read-only (GET). All changes are rejected with 403.
apiKeys.createdWarning: Copy the key now. It is shown only this once and cannot be retrieved again.
apiKeys.empty: There are no API keys yet.
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke the API key "{name}"? Integrations using it stop working immediately.

errors.forbidden: Only an administrator can manage API keys.
errors.invalid: Enter a name of 1–80 characters and a valid future expiry date.

security.errorPassword: Incorrect password. The 2FA settings were not changed.
security.errorSetupExpired: The setup has expired. Start the setup again.
security.title: Two-factor authentication (TOTP)
security.desc: Use an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, etc.).
security.step1: 1. Scan the QR code with your app.
security.manual: Can't scan? Enter the key manually:
security.step2: 2. Enter the code from the app
security.codeLabel: One-time code from the authenticator app
security.cancelPlaceholder: Confirm with your password to cancel
security.disableDesc: Enter a valid one-time code to disable.

recoveryCodes.title: Recovery codes
recoveryCodes.desc: Store these codes somewhere safe. They are shown only now, and each code can be used once if you lose your authenticator app.
recoveryCodes.warning: These codes are shown only this one time. Save them before closing the box.
recoveryCodes.regenerated: New recovery codes have been created. The old codes are no longer valid.
recoveryCodes.regenerateDesc: Creates a new set and invalidates all old codes. Confirm with your password and a code from the app.
recoveryCodes.fileWarning: Each code can be used once. Keep the file in a safe place.

templateBuilder.name: Checklist name
templateBuilder.descriptionHint: Shown in the template library to help others choose the right template.
templateBuilder.hmsTypeHint: Controls which group the form appears in under the HMS library.
templateBuilder.emptyTitle: This template has no fields yet.
templateBuilder.emptyDesc: Use the buttons below to build the form with the field types you need.
templateBuilder.fieldPlaceholder: Write a question or field name...
templateBuilder.optionsStatusPlaceholder: E.g. OK, Deviation, To be fixed, Not applicable
templateBuilder.commentOptionsLabel: 💬 A comment is required for these options (separated by commas):
templateBuilder.commentOptionsHelp: When the technician selects one of these, they must write a comment on that line. Clear the field to never require a comment.
templateBuilder.reportNameHint: The name shown in the PDF and report lists. Empty uses the checklist name.
templateBuilder.requiresUnits: Link the report to equipment units
templateBuilder.requiresUnitsHint: Turn off when the report does not concern specific units. The checkpoints are then completed once for the whole work order.

workorders_view.label: View work orders
workorders_view.description: View work orders belonging to your own department.

workorders_create.label: Create work orders
workorders_create.description: Create new work orders in your own department.

workorders_update.label: Update work orders
workorders_update.description: Change status, comments, attachments and checklists on work orders in your own department.

workorders_edit.label: Edit work orders
workorders_edit.description: Change title, customer, date, contact person, tags, templates and cancel work orders.

workorders_assign.label: Assign technicians
workorders_assign.description: Assign and remove technicians on work orders in your own department.

workorders_delete.label: Delete work orders
workorders_delete.description: Delete work orders and everything related (reports, comments, attachments). Administrator only by default.

customers_view.label: View customers
customers_view.description: View customer cards, contacts, agreements and history.

customers_manage.label: Manage customers
customers_manage.description: Create and change customers, contacts, service agreements and customer portal users.

equipment_manage.label: Manage equipment
equipment_manage.description: Add and change equipment on customer cards.

reports_view.label: View reports
reports_view.description: View and download service reports from your own department.

reports_write.label: Fill in reports
reports_write.description: Fill in and save checklists on work orders in your own department.

reports_viewAllDepartments.label: View reports from all departments
reports_viewAllDepartments.description: View and download reports from departments other than your own. Administrators always have this access.

documents_view.label: View documents
documents_view.description: Use the document library and view generated documents.

documents_manage.label: Manage documents
documents_manage.description: Upload, edit and organise documents and folders.

templates_manage.label: Manage checklists
templates_manage.description: Create and edit checklists, templates and tags.

users_view.label: View employees
users_view.description: View employees, roles and department affiliation in your own department.

users_manage.label: Manage employees
users_manage.description: Create users, change roles and send invitations in your own department. Only administrators can move employees between departments.

map.title: Map settings
map.description: Choose map provider, default layer and how the map behaves.
map.keyStored: A key is stored – leave blank to keep it
map.keyHint: The key is stored on the server and sent only to the map in the browser. Use a domain-restricted key when supported.
map.centerHint: Optional. Used when there are no work orders to fit the map to.
map.missingKey: An API key is required for this provider.
map.invalid: Invalid map settings. Check the fields.

equipmentCategories.title: Equipment categories
equipmentCategories.description: Manage categories and hierarchy for equipment and units. Categories are used when registering and filtering equipment.
equipmentCategories.name: Category name
equipmentCategories.inUse: The category is in use and cannot be deleted.
equipmentCategories.empty: No categories have been created yet.
equipmentCategories.readOnly: You can view categories but not change them. Contact a user with equipment editing access.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Turn installation-level modules on or off. Core is always on, and dependencies prevent invalid combinations. Every change is audited.
modules.dataPreserved: Data is retained when a module is turned off. Pages, actions, APIs and workers are closed; nothing is deleted. Turn the module back on and the data returns.
modules.missingDependencies: Cannot be enabled until these are on: {modules}
modules.hasDependents: Cannot be disabled while these are on: {modules}
modules.confirmDisable: Disable {module}? Data is retained, but pages, actions and workers are closed.
modules.saved: The module change was saved and audited.

errors.forbidden: Only an administrator can change modules.
errors.conflict: The change conflicts with module dependencies.
errors.missingDependencies: One or more dependencies are off.
errors.hasDependents: One or more modules that use this are on.
errors.error: Could not save the module change.

core.label: Core
core.description: Always on: authentication, users, departments, customers, work orders, workdays and time, audit and settings.

calendar.label: Calendar and dispatch
calendar.description: Calendar, dispatch board, route planning and capacity overview.

reports.label: Reports and HSE
reports.description: Service reports, HSE, checklists and templates, PDF viewer and statistics.

equipment.label: Equipment
equipment.description: Equipment register, service history, QR/scan and maintenance plans.

contracts.label: Service contracts and SLA
contracts.description: Service contracts, SLA policies, business hours and price lists.

portal.label: Customer portal
portal.description: Customers’ own portal for work orders, reports, documents and contact details.

booking.label: Bookings
booking.description: Customer booking requests and available slots. Requires portal and calendar.

documents.label: Documents
documents.description: Document library, folders, versions and text extraction/OCR.

sms.label: SMS and reminders
sms.description: SMS messages, templates, delivery status and reminders before visits.

map.label: Map
map.description: Map of work orders, equipment and technician positions.

tracking.label: Tracking and ETA
tracking.description: Public tracking link and real-time ETA for visits.

reviews.label: Reviews
reviews.description: Customer reviews from public links and internal follow-up.

transfer.label: Customer transfer
transfer.description: Export and import of customer packages. Requires equipment and documents.

auditExport.label: Audit and evidence export
auditExport.description: Signed audit export and evidence packages for work orders.

api.label: REST API
api.description: API v1 with API keys, scopes and OpenAPI documentation.

sso.label: SSO and SCIM
sso.description: OIDC login, SCIM provisioning and SSO settings.

offline.label: Offline field
offline.description: Field app offline drafts, outbox queue and session guard.

quotes.label: Quotes (P2)
quotes.description: Quotes and estimates. Not delivered yet.

invoicing.label: Invoicing (P2)
invoicing.description: Invoicing and payment. Not delivered yet.

inventory.label: Inventory (P2)
inventory.description: Inventory, parts and purchasing. Not delivered yet.

fieldExpenses.label: Mileage and expenses (P2)
fieldExpenses.description: Mileage log, expenses and payroll export. Not delivered yet.

bi.label: Profitability (P2)
bi.description: Profitability and report builder. Not delivered yet.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Create custom roles, change their permissions, or remove roles that are no longer in use.

invite.sent: The invitation email has been sent. The user sets their own password, and you activate the account afterwards.
invite.manual: The email could not be sent (check the SMTP settings in .env), so send this link to the user manually. They set their own password, and you activate the account afterwards.
invite.failed: Could not create the invitation link. Please try again.

add.title: Add new user
add.noRoles: No roles are available. Ask an administrator to create or assign a role.
add.departmentHelp: Employees must belong to a department to create and see work orders.
add.contactHelp: Links the user to the customer and gives access to the customer portal.
add.info: New users are inactive. After you create them, you get an invitation link they can use to set their own password. Then you must activate the account here.

list.title: All users in the system
list.resetTwoFactorHint: Disable two-factor authentication for a user who has lost their device
list.resetTwoFactorConfirm: Disable two-factor authentication for “{name}”? The user must set up 2FA again, and all sessions are signed out.
list.adminHint: Administrators always have all permissions, regardless of the role's list.
list.customerHint: Customer portal users are controlled by their customer link, not by internal permissions.
list.permissionsDesc: The list overrides the role. Leave it equal to the role's permissions to keep following the role.
list.readOnly: Only an administrator can change this user.

errors.missingContact: Customer portal users must be linked to a contact person on the customer card.
errors.duplicateEmail: A user with this email address already exists.

settings.description: Send notifications to the mobile app through FCM (Android) and APNs (iOS).
settings.noSecrets: Keys and tokens are never shown here.
settings.neverSent: No push has been sent yet.
settings.testDescription: Delivered to your own registered devices.
settings.testNoDevices: No active devices were found for your account.
settings.testNotConfigured: Push is not configured. Add the FCM or APNs setup first.
settings.cleanupDescription: Deletes disabled devices and devices not seen for {days} days.
